Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The accused/petitioners are named in the FIR and apprehending their arrest in connection with Mahnar P.S. Case No.129 of 2024 registered under Sections 366(A), 376, 511/34 of the Indian Penal Code (in short 'I.P.C.') and Section 8, 12 POCSO Act.

3. The allegations against the petitioners, who are women, is to help the main co-accused Pinkesh Kumar, who made an attempt to outrage the minor daughter of the informant aged about 15 years and the present petitioners were talking Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.56916 of 2025(2)
dt.07-11-2025 selling her at Kolkata.
The occurrence alleged to be taken place at Chakla Shahi.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners that the present implications took place out of certain neighbourhood dispute and differences, which now appears to have been Babi Devi @ Bebi Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40770777/
1 compromised and thereafter a compromise petition was preferred by the informant before the learned Special Court itself, retracting the earlier version of the allegations.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that even as per the FIR, the thrust of allegation is available against Pinkesh Kumar and not against these petitioners.
Petitioners, who are women, are said to be of clean antecedents.
5. Learned APP has opposed the prayer of bail.
6. Mr. Satish Kumar Sinha, learned counsel appearing for the informant also approves the factum of compromise as submitted aforesaid.

7. Considering the aforesaid factual submissions and by taking note of the fact as allegations as per the FIR is mainly available against co-accused Pinkesh Kumar, who is not the petitioner for the present coupled with the fact that the issues and differences out of which the present implications was raised also appears compromised, accordingly, the petitioners, above- Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.56916 of 2025(2) dt.07-11-2025 named, who are ladies of clean antecedents, are directed to be released on bail, in the event of their arrest or surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned District and Additional Sessions Judge-VIth-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Vaishali, Hajipur, in connection with Mahnar P.S. Case No.129/2024 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Pawan/-
